text:
maya_prod: Heads-up — planning to enable twilight-3b-v2 in the model catalog tomorrow during the 02:00PT change window. Canary in us-west1 then eu. Need final pinlist for priority customers and explicit fallback ordering. Quick plan below.

ben.murphy: +1. what’s the canary size and traffic shift cadence?

maya_prod: Canary plan: 5% initial for 30m, then 25% for 1h, then 100% after checks. Rollback triggers: error rate > 1% or p99 latency regression > 200ms vs baseline for 15m.

alice.kim: Suggest fallback ladder: twilight-3b-quant-fast -> twilight-3b-8bit -> twilight-2.8b-fp16. Keep current legacy pinned for enterprise accounts (do not auto-swap).

elliott_sre: +1 to thresholds. Add saturation guard: queue depth > 10k for 5m -> trigger throttle/rollback. Watch for GPU OOMs and node eviction.

carla_docs: I’ll draft a short release note. What behaviour should we call out re: sampling defaults vs deterministic pins?

ben.murphy: New default sampling is top-p=0.95. Docs should recommend pinning top-p/temperature for customers requiring deterministic outputs.

dani.engineering: Need per-customer pin flag. For customers on Dedicated capacity, do not swap models unless they explicitly opt in.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Preflight checklist: canary job created for twilight-3b-v2, scheduled start 3150005400. Jobs: catalog-enable-check, telemetry-hook, rollback-monitor.

ops-bot: [ops-bot] Preflight OK — infra capacity reserved (10 GPUs). Canary config checksum: abc123def.

ben.murphy: Rolling config snippet for ops reference:
```json
{
  "model": "twilight-3b-v2",
  "canary": { "initial_pct": 5, "steps": [25, 100], "step_interval_min": 60 }
}
```

alice.kim: Also add a fallback priority map entry in the catalog metadata: prefer quantized fast variant first to reduce cost. Add an evaluation gate: quality delta < 2% on the twilight-evals baseline set.

elliott_sre: I’ll hook up the synthetic traffic and SLO monitors. Escalation rule: if p99 latency delta > 200ms or error rate >1% for 15m -> alert oncall and pause rollout.

maya_prod: Action items: carla publish release note draft, alice update catalog fallback map, dani implement per-customer pin flag, elliott enable SLO alerts. Change window: 02:00PT–05:00PT. Canary start at 02:05PT.

carla_docs: Draft posted: https://docs.internal/release/twilight-3b-v2 (preview). Included pinning guidance and sampling note.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary started (3150005405) — routing 5% traffic to twilight-3b-v2 in us-west1. Telemetry stream: http://telemetry.internal/twilight/3150005405

maya_prod: Monitoring first 15 minutes closely. If green, proceed to 25% at 02:35PT.

elliott_sre: Oncall here, monitoring SLOs and infra metrics. Will call if anything spikes.

ben.murphy: If we hit rollback, who performs the pin rollback? eng-run or ops?

dani.engineering: eng-run will flip catalog pins (automated rollback job). ops will restore infra if needed. I’ll own rollback execution and post-mortem.

maya_prod: Thanks — post any rollback decisions here and open an incident if we trigger. :thumbsup:

carla_docs: Release notes published to external KB; internal changelog updated.

maya_prod: Final: proceeding as planned. Will close this thread after the 03:00PT check-in if everything remains green.
